title: Benchmrk for gyms and personal trainers
desc: Every member gets their own plan, built on your programme. How gyms and personal trainers use Benchmrk: gym code, your own sim programmes, members who follow your build-up.
foot.hyrox: Benchmrk is not affiliated with HYROX.
hero.h1: Every member their own plan. Your build-up.
hero.sub: Benchmrk builds an improvement plan for every member on their own threshold, around their own week. You decide how sims build up in your gym. Your members follow your programme.
hero.note: Free for gyms in the beta · gym code and your own sim programmes · Nederlands, English, Deutsch, Español, 한국어

how.title: How your gym starts
st1.d: You get a gym account with its own gym code and invite link. Under “My gym” you set your equipment and your sim programmes.
st2.d: Members create an account through your link and are linked straight away. They follow your sim build-up and your gym’s equipment.
st3.d: Paces, heart-rate limits, race date and division stay per member. The plan adapts to what each member logs.
split.title: What you decide, what stays per member
split.l1: How the sim builds up, in blocks of weeks
split.l2: The equipment: HYROX gym, regular gym or home
split.l3: Which sim programme your members follow
split.r1: Threshold pace and threshold heart rate
split.r2: Race date, division and goal time
split.note: If you change your programme, your members’ plans recalculate straight away.
feat.title: What your gym gets
f1.d: Rounds, and per block of weeks the percentage of the race kilometre and of the station volume. Up to 20 programmes per gym.
f2.d: If a member trains at home, they get replacement exercises for the stations. Same goal, different equipment.
f3.d: Members log your WOD with a photo of the whiteboard; the app reads the board. A WOD with RPE 8 or higher counts as a hard day.
f4.d: A team prediction and a split of the turns per station between the partners.
pt.title: Personal trainer? You coach, Benchmrk calculates.
pt.text: Benchmrk is free for you. You earn {pct}% commission on every paid membership of the athletes you bring, for every year they renew. Applications are approved by hand; payout per quarter on invoice.
sci.line: Every training rule is backed by sources your members can read themselves
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
q1: What does Benchmrk cost for my gym?
a1: A gym account is free in the beta. Your members pay their own membership ({price} per year in the beta).
q2: Do all my members get the same plan?
a2: No. The sim build-up is the same, but paces, heart-rate limits, race date and division are per member.
q3: How do members link to my gym?
a3: Through your invite link, or with the gym code under Settings. They can leave the gym again.
q4: What is in a sim programme?
a4: The number of rounds and, per block of weeks, the percentage of the race kilometre and of the station volume. The last block ends in the week before race week.
q5: Can members train without a gym?
a5: Yes. They then follow Benchmrk’s standard build-up or their own.
end.title: Let your members train for their goal time.
